description_en: Adds tags to simple application servers, snapshots, custom images, commands, firewall rules, and disks to facilitate the viewing and management of the preceding resources
description_zh: 对轻量应用服务器、快照、自定义镜像、命令、防火墙规则和磁盘绑定标签，便于查看和管理轻量资源
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --resource-id s-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The client token that you want to use to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

instance
snapshot
customimage
command
firewallrule
disk
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值范围：

instance：实例。
snapshot：快照。
customimage：自定义镜像。
command：命令。
firewallrule：防火墙规则。
disk：磁盘
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of tag N that you want to add to a resource.

You cannot specify an empty string as a tag key. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. The tag key cannot start with acs: or aliyun
fields.help_zh:
为轻量资源指定的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of tag N that you want to add to a resource.

You can specify an empty string as a tag value. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
为轻量资源指定的标签值。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag
